page: Amazon Web Services c5ad.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by AMD EPYC 7R32 processors. It features 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores with 2 threads per core running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store volumes and a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, managed by the Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile. While single-core CPU performance in stress-ng is in the bottom 10%, multi-core CPU performance is average. However, the instance demonstrates strong capabilities in specific areas, scoring in the top 25% for Passmark CPU, physics, and extended instructions tests. Cryptographic performance is particularly notable, with the Passmark CPU encryption test ranking in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth for cached small blocks is strong, though uncached large block reads and writes fall into the average category.

The instance exhibits a tradeoff between single-core processing speed and multi-threaded throughput. It achieves strong results in software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing, alongside strong Redis SET operations and database operations. It is suited for multi-threaded workloads, database operations, and tasks requiring high-speed local NVMe storage, such as temporary data processing, caching layers, and distributed build systems.
